name: SetAutoLogin
transaction_boundary: DPAPI protect/validation completes before one LLD-01 UnitOfWork records enabled state; disable commits state before best-effort envelope removal
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> prepare/verify DPAPI envelope when enabling -> command_receipt -> state/revision -> audit -> commit -> atomic envelope publish or cleanup according to algorithm
mutations: security_auto_login insert/update of enabled state and token verifier projection
revision_effects: security_auto_login.revision initializes at 1 on first persisted state and increments exactly once on each semantic APPLIED change; committed replay/NO_CHANGE increments nothing
post_commit_work: publish the already-verified owner-bound DPAPI envelope atomically when enabling or remove stale envelope material after committed disable according to the auto-login algorithm; post-commit file work does not change database revisions
rules: browser never receives raw auto-login token
